changes: First release of the partner API: properties, room types, rooms, availability, rates, reservations, guests, folios, housekeeping, daily reports and webhook endpoints.
Signed webhooks with retries for 24 hours, replay and test pings.
Test keys (`hk_test_`) run every write as a dry run.
